steps.content: Nino, Mom and Dad are off to work now. Take good care of yourself, sweetheart...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Okay...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Then... when are you coming back?
Hmm... next week! We'll bring back your favorite doll!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Okay! I'll wait for you!
Haha... I know our Nino is a good girl!
By the way, how's school? Have you made any friends?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I'm doing quite well... As for friends... soon...
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: What about this time?
Hmm... Half a month.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: That's a long time...
Because Mom and Dad have a lot of work to do.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Alright then, I'll take good care of myself...
I heard the host who bought the land has invited all the old fighters back.
Nino... We'll be away for more than a month this time. Listen to Grandma, okay?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: ...Okay.
Grandma said you've been using that old computer a lot lately. She's quite worried. Talk to her more often.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: ...Okay.
Also... don't always go on strange websites... What if you get a virus...
The noisy radio waves fill her eardrums. The young girl tries to grasp everything in front of her, but finds herself floating in a chaotic space.
One after another, the scenes play on a loop before her eyes.
Her schoolmates looked down on her poor family and dull clothes. No one wanted to be close to her.
Only the old lady next door would occasionally give her food and a kind smile.
Grandma passed away. It was just the flu, but elderly people could be fragile. They leave you so suddenly, without any warning.
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Hello, I am...

steps.speaker: Classmate A
steps.content: Tsk, it's that country bumpkin again. Ignore her...

steps.speaker: Classmate B
steps.content: Shush, she can hear you...

steps.speaker: Classmate A
steps.content: So? You know what, we should keep talking about Legion of Warcraft. She has no idea what it is anyway.

steps.speaker: Classmate A
steps.content: Remember to teach me how to beat that first boss, otherwise I won't be able to play with everyone!

steps.speaker: Classmate B
steps.content: Haha... Sorry about that, bumpkin. We've got something more important to do... Let's talk another day?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Legion... of Warcraft...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Play... with everyone...
(Scene change)
Loneliness drives you mad. After all, humans are social creatures.
This computer was one of the few things her parents left her. She started to go on the internet, play games, and join online communities.
This is an alternative reality, where one experiences a second life with an identity different from their real one.

steps.speaker: Captain
steps.content: It's all written clearly in the team name: Four Dragons advanced team, looking for serious and experienced players, no noobs.

steps.speaker: Captain
steps.content: Can't you read or what? Kicked you out several times and you're still trying to squeeze in? Are you geared enough to join?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Sorry... I'm sorry...
Seeing the girl in newbie gear tears up, the heavily armored fighter's attitude softens a bit.

steps.speaker: Captain
steps.content: Tsk... Just go. If I let you in with your gear score, you'll only be a burden to the others. Gear up before you go for this instance.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Um...

steps.speaker: Captain
steps.content: Huh? What is it now?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: What does gear score mean?
The heavily armored fighter slaps his forehead.

steps.speaker: Captain
steps.content: Are you joking?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I... I really don't know. I only started playing... a week ago...
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Teammate A
steps.content: Why didn't you tell him off? You played so well, why did you take the blame? Obviously, we failed because he didn't know what he was doing.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I... I just don't want people... to fight... After all, we're... all friends...

steps.speaker: Teammate A
steps.content: Sigh, it's rare to see such an innocent kid on the internet these days...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Innocent...?

steps.speaker: Teammate A
steps.content: Look, when it comes to everything online, you gotta be objective. Treat the person and the matter separately!

steps.speaker: Teammate A
steps.content: If someone does something wrong or upsets you, you need to tell them loud and clear! Let them know they've messed up!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Do... do we have to be this strict? We're all frie...

steps.speaker: Teammate A
steps.content: Not friends, just online acquaintances!

steps.speaker: Teammate A
steps.content: Next time you come across an ******* like that, you give them hell, got it? Keeping everything bottled up only hurts you! Understand?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I, I got it!

steps.speaker: Teammate A
steps.content: Got it, huh? Then repeat after me. You ******* *******! If you suck, just admit it before you join, that way we can at least train you. Now you're just wasting our time with your half-assed skills, you *******!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Half... Half-as... I can't... I can't say it...

steps.speaker: Captain
steps.content: You! Stop teaching little Nino your useless crap!

steps.speaker: Teammate A
steps.content: Chill out... I'm just teaching the kid how to decompress. We don't want her to get a burnout from the pent-up feelings! It's not useless at all... Haha...
(Scene change)
Soon, she obtained some rare armor and formed her own squad. With her excellent skills and thorough understanding of the game, she naturally became the core of the team.
These people came together because of her. For the first time, she understood what it felt like to be in the spotlight, at the center of attention.
The greetings she got from everyone upon logging into the game became what she looked forward to the most every day.

steps.speaker: Squad Member A
steps.content: Captain's online so early today? I know, I know, not having a job is the coolest thing!

steps.speaker: Squad Member B
steps.content: Nino, help us out, we can't do this instance without you!

steps.speaker: Squad Member C
steps.content: Two guys are arguing again. I'm sure they'll listen if Nino goes to stop them!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Okay... Um... Can you guys speak one at a time? I can't keep up if you all talk at once...
(Scene change)
But all good things must come to an end. Due to various reasons, that game was shut down not long after.
She simply assumed that everyone would be reunited in another similar game.
But that wasn't the case. After all, those who gamed for a living were very much in the minority.
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Squad Member A
steps.content: Sorry, Nino, I've found a job. I'll start working next month.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I see... No worries.

steps.speaker: Squad Member B
steps.content: Hey, Nino, I'm sorry... but I'm leaving for FAC trial training soon, so I'm probably not able to play anymore...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Oh... That's a good thing. I'm happy for you...

steps.speaker: Squad Member C
steps.content: Nino, you're not like me. You're so good at the game, you should totally become a streamer for another game!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Haha... A streamer? I... I can't do that...

steps.speaker: Squad Member C
steps.content: Why don't you just give it a try? You never know!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Sigh... If only we could keep playing...

Some chose to return to their real lives, some began to get tired of the game, and some even died in reality fighting against Mania... One by one, they left. In the end, she found herself all alone once again.
In order to feel needed and to make friends again, she tried her hand at streaming.
She made her image similar to Nino Sama, her character who once dominated Legion of Warcraft with two super rare armor pieces.
Surely viewers would be attracted by her glorious reputation, she thought.
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Hi everyone... My name is Nino and I've just recently started streaming. Feel free to follow my channel. I'll be streaming my gaming session... every night.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: If you like my... videos, please click the follow button in the upper right corner to subscribe.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Some of the regulars didn't show up today. The livestream felt a lot quieter than usual...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I've only gained a few hundred fans after streaming for half a year. I guess soon I'll be doing my graduation stream? Haha, just joking.
The quiet livestream became the norm. Sometimes, even a single follow would make her day, because that meant she gained a new friend again.
Nino's streaming career didn't pick up after six months. Right before she decided to give up, it happened.
During what would have become her outdoor graduation stream, she encountered the Corruptors.
Endless Mania power was devouring her. To survive, she kept running, exhausting every last bit of her strength.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Grandma, am I going to see you soon?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I... I don't want to die! I don't want to die...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I... want to live! I... want someone to care about me! I... still haven't been surrounded by friends yet!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I can't die... I won't die!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: ******* Corruptors! I swear I'll destroy you! Even if it costs me my life!
She let her emotions burst out of her, cursing everything she saw, changing into a completely different person from her previous submissive self.
A pixelated sword-shield appeared in her hands. It was her favorite weapon in Legion of Warcraft.
At that moment, Nino metamorphosed into Nino, the Nino she had always dreamed of becoming.
All of this was silently recorded by the camera.
Her ability was activated, and all at once, every audiovisual device in Eastside became connected to her livestream.
It was just a nameless girl cursing the world on her last breath, yet it resonated with countless viewers at the moment.
These waves of emotions collided and traveled back into the girl's body with the reverberations.
The powerful energy allowed the girl to survive Mania's corruption, but before she could rejoice, she realized the problem.
Layers of emotional ripples reflected at each other, breaching the girl's rational defenses like a dam-breaking tide.
The repercussions of her power would continue to spread and intensify, eventually growing into a massive force that could destroy her physically and mentally.
But she couldn't stop now. At the moment she came under the gaze of all the media in Eastside, that recognition-greedy monster within her swallowed her whole.
Having experienced the feeling of being wanted and the attention, she no longer wanted to return to that cramped, dark corner of the past.
Even if she knew this could lead to her end, she'd rather die under the world's admiration.
This is also the price Nino must pay to become Nino.
As her power grew stronger, her viewership also surged, which in turn strengthened her power further.
And you're looking at the consequence.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Cough, cough...
Alone in that space, the girl coughs up a black liquid uncontrollably.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Haha... I should have known this long ago.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Just like a moth to a flame... In the end, it's unattainable...
The flashbacks stop. Inside that chaotic space, Nino gives a self-mocking smile.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Is this how it ends? Bummer, I wish I could have died during a stream...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: But I guess this ending isn't that bad.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Isn't loneliness the gist of my life?
Nino, where are you? We're less busy this year. We're back to see you.
Isn't Nino so cute when she's a bit fierce?
How come there are so few people watching? Where are the others? Yay, Nino Sama is all mine then!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: These... idiots...
One after another, figures appear, many of whom Nino has never seen before.
They might be Nino's former teammates, former audience, or even those who once hated on her.
The figures slowly gather, filling the boundless chaotic space.
With them comes a soft voice calling her name.
Nino, keep on playing. If I could play with you, that would be even better!
She reaches out and gently touches the ray of light.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Of course you're an idiot too, trying to save a troublemaker like me.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: It's my fault... I've worried you all...
(Scene change)
You successfully seal Nino's unbridled power with the shackles and wake her from unconsciousness.
Waking up, Nino seems somewhat different.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...That's the conclusion of the analysis department's investigation into your ability.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: To prevent similar incidents from happening again, certain restrictions will be placed on your livestream in the future.
Hearing your words, the girl across from you widens her eyes in terror, then suddenly lunges forward in an attempt to grab your leg, but you dodge her.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: What!!! No way, you can't do that!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Exactly how long will that last? When can I resume streaming normally?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Until you fully master your own ability, of course.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Needless to say, before that, I won't completely ban your livestream. I can let you loose from time to time, and when necessary, my presence also serves as an extra layer of shackles... I mean, an extra layer of protection.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Hehe, that means if I go manic again, Chief will personally save me again!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm not your underling. I can't watch you all the time. You should learn to control your ability as soon as possible.

Of course, to make up for the complaints and compensation regarding your previous livestream, you will also need to perform certain types of labor within the Bureau, including but not limited to cleaning and other menial tasks. The income from your livestream will also be used to pay off your debt.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: How heartless!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Is it just me or your attitude toward me has been progressively more presumptuous ever since I saved you?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: That only goes to show that we're getting along perfectly!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Speaking of which, try to reach out to different people in the Bureau, including the other Sinners. I think you can become friends. As Sinners, I'm sure you can connect with each other easily.
The girl who's just been teasing you suddenly seems reserved and somewhat flustered.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: You... You really think so? It's one thing to talk to others online, but interacting with Sinners in real life... I feel a bit...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Just avoid those cringey skits of yours and you'll be fine.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: What did you say?! Did you just insult Nino Sama's genius livestream again!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Prejudice! This is blatant prejudice against me!
(Scene change)
Another peaceful afternoon. You watch as Nino bounces toward the Sinners in the rest area.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Thankfully, you foresaw the outburst of Nino's power, so that we could prevent any casualties that could potentially be caused by that incident. Everything went as you'd predicted.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's nothing. I've only developed a hunch for danger, having been through it so much.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I'm afraid there's one more thing that requires your attention.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Yes?
On the tablet handed over by Nightingale, the previous most-viewed video on Nino's page has been replaced by another video. It's the livestream right before that arrest operation.
Among the related videos, there is another highly viewed video titled Shocking! MBCC Chief Disguises as Delivery Person to Deceive Innocent Streamer.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The video recording of that arrest operation has spread quickly on the internet, so her livestream that evening has gone viral too.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Who posted the video?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: It seems to be the deliveryman that night.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Sure, Chief.
